profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack software engineer with 9 years of experience contributing to as well as leading in a wide variety of technologies and team structures.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an MVP backend for a gamified employee task management application pilot program for Dragon Army.

	•	Built scalable backend solutions for an MVP web app deployed across 10 test locations, designed to gamify employee tasks, boosting engagement and productivity.
	•	Implemented secure, passwordless authentication using AWS Cognito Custom Authentication Challenge with Lambda triggers.
	•	Engineered backend services to deliver real-time, web-based push notifications leveraging AWS Lambda and Web Push API, simulating native mobile app experiences.
	•	Designed dynamic leaderboard functionality using AWS Lambda and DynamoDB to track and display employee performance, automating weekly performance summaries.
	•	Developed backend data processing functions to analyze task completion rates, delivering actionable insights to pilot location managers.
	•	Utilized AWS infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, SES, SNS, EventBridge, CloudFormation, S3) to build efficient and scalable backend solutions.

Technologies: AWS Lambda, Cognito, DynamoDB, SES, SNS, EventBridge, CloudFormation, S3, Web Push API, AWS Amplify
positions.insights: Skills: React · PostgreSQL · Full-Stack Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Databases

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and optimized data engineering pipelines supporting healthcare analytics.

	•	Built scalable data transformation pipelines using DBT and Apache Airflow, organizing complex workflows into Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).
	•	Leveraged Airflow to pinpoint pipeline bottlenecks, specifically targeting slow-running PostgreSQL queries; subsequently rewrote and optimized queries to significantly reduce execution time and improve pipeline performance.
	•	Integrated and transformed extensive healthcare datasets from providers, insurers, and government entities (e.g., CMS), enabling predictive analytics on patient populations.

Technologies: SQL, PostgreSQL, DBT, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, Python, Kafka
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Full-Stack Development · SQL · Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and deployed Ethereum-based NFT marketplace features.

	•	Engineered and deployed secure ERC-721 NFT smart contracts to Ethereum mainnet, adhering strictly to blockchain security best practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, including reentrancy attacks.
	•	Implemented frontend interfaces enabling seamless user interactions with smart contracts through Web3.js and React.
	•	Ensured compliance with OpenSea metadata standards, storing assets securely on decentralized IPFS storage for increased resiliency and reliability.

Technologies: Ethereum, Solidity, React, AWS (s3, CloudFront, WAF), IPFS, Hardhat, Foundry,
Infura, Piñata
positions.insights: Skills: foundry · pinata · React · hardhat · Solidity · Full-Stack Development · ethers · Ethereum · aws s3 · aws waf · Smart Contracts · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Databases

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer - Zevtron
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Led development and enhancement of a software platform managing electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

	•	Served as the sole engineer responsible for maintaining and upgrading the backend system controlling electric vehicle chargers (EVSE).
	•	Implemented significant improvements to core synchronization algorithms, reducing system exceptions by 30%.
	•	Executed a complete UI redesign, improving user experience and application responsiveness.
	•	Managed daily interactions with stakeholders, establishing agile methodologies and regular two-week sprint cycles to consistently deliver feature enhancements and fixes.
	•	Oversaw integration and collaboration efforts with third-party partners, ensuring smooth interoperability and functionality.

Technologies: C#, .NET Framework 4.6, Azure Functions, JavaScript, AngularJS, SQL, Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer - Coinbase
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Enhanced Coinbase’s blockchain-based NFT marketplace

	•	Contributed to frontend development by building modular, reusable React-based UI components integrated seamlessly with blockchain APIs.
	•	Developed and deployed an end-to-end feature displaying ownership counts for ERC-1155 tokens, coordinating changes across backend services and frontend components.
	•	Built an automated testing framework for UX flows interacting directly with the blockchain, utilizing Hardhat to fork Ethereum locally, enabling repeatable, deterministic testing scenarios at specific blockchain states.

Technologies: Next.js, React, Relay, Web3.js, Ethers, Cypress, Hardhat, Go, gRPC, Protocol Buffers

positions.title: Software Engineer - Zenimax
positions.description:
Developed “Admin Tools,” a microservices-based platform supporting video game studios in managing development workflows.

	•	Architected and implemented backend APIs in Go, providing robust and performant CRUD operations and secure database interactions.
	•	Developed micro-frontend SPAs tailored to individual studio requirements, enabling modularity, scalability, and maintainability across different projects.
	•	Engineered comprehensive database schemas, role management systems, and optimized complex SQL queries and stored procedures.
	•	Built a secure JWT-based JavaScript HTTP request wrapper, simplifying frontend-backend integration and authentication flows.
	•	Created reusable React components stored in Storybook for consistent UI patterns and streamlined frontend development processes.
	•	Designed and implemented automated testing strategies, including extensive unit testing and Cypress-based integration testing, significantly enhancing code reliability.
	•	Improved build performance and deployment efficiency by optimizing bundle sizes and refining AWS CloudFormation templates for automated infrastructure deployment.

Technologies: Go, React, Cypress, MySQL, Protocol Buffers, gRPC, AWS (S3, CloudFormation)

positions.title: Software Engineer - Riot Games
positions.description:
Contributed to the development of Riot’s next-generation game delivery platform.

	•	Developed installer features enabling users to dynamically change the game installation location seamlessly.
	•	Built user interfaces using Qt, a cross-platform C++ UI framework, integrating backend logic with intuitive frontend interactions.
	•	Collaborated with product and QA teams to refine the installation process, improving reliability, performance, and overall user experience.
	•	Addressed technical challenges related to filesystem interactions and ensured robust handling of edge cases during installation flows.

Technologies: C++, Qt, React, Perforce

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - Classy
positions.description:
Classy is a fundraising platform tailored to nonprofit organizations.

Responsible for designing and implementing core application architecture, including backend APIs, database schemas, and DevOps workflows, enabling seamless fundraising operations for nonprofit clients.
	•	Designed and developed a robust Node.js-based CSV processing solution, utilizing child processes to efficiently handle large CSV uploads without blocking the event loop. The parser charged customer accounts via API calls and automatically notified users upon completion.
	•	Integrated JWT-based authentication for secure frontend-to-backend communication.
	•	Established and maintained reliable CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and Git workflows, enhancing deployment efficiency and reducing release cycles.
	•	Built and optimized backend services and React-based frontend features to improve user experience and platform scalability.

Technologies: JavaScript, React, Node, Cypress, Mocha, JWT, MySQL, AWS (CloudFront, S3, EC2, RDS, Route53, SES), Nginx, PM2, CircleCi

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - DisconnectNow
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Startup focused on promoting safe driving through mobile device management.

	•	Led engineering efforts to rapidly complete the Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
	•	Designed and implemented unified webhook-based payment processing, integrating seamlessly with both Apple and Google app store payments.
	•	Streamlined backend logic, consolidating diverse payment flows into a cohesive and maintainable solution.

Technologies: JavaScript, PHP, Webhooks, Android Studio, Apple App Store APIs, Google Play APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer - Blue Star Sports
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Modernization of legacy sports management applications.

	•	Refactored and modernized legacy application codebase, transitioning key features to React and JavaScript.
	•	Integrated AWS Cognito Single Sign-On (SSO) solution, streamlining user authentication across platforms.
	•	Improved overall UI/UX, enhancing usability and modernizing frontend interface design.

Technologies: JavaScript, React, PHP, PostgreSQL, AWS Cognito

positions.title: Software Engineer - League Lineup
positions.description:
Payment integration for legacy sports platform.

	•	Integrated a custom-built payment gateway into an existing legacy system, enabling flexible transactions while maintaining compatibility with PayPal.
	•	Designed and implemented API interactions, ensuring seamless transition for existing users.
	•	Improved reliability of payment processing, reducing friction in user checkout experiences.

Technologies: JavaScript, PHP, jQuery, MySQL, Legacy Application Integration

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developed COMPAS, an award-winning application suite enhancing patient care and clinical operations.

	•	Led architecture design, API structure, database schemas, and user experience improvements across the COMPAS application suite, significantly optimizing patient workflow management.
	•	Principal developer of an administrative management application centralizing the setup and configuration processes, streamlining clinical workflow management.
	•	Engineered real-time tracking features enabling medical staff to efficiently monitor patient locations, status, and waiting times, directly impacting operational efficiency and care quality.
	•	Recognized with the California Health Care Safety Net Institute’s top honor (2016) and Vizient’s national Clinical Innovation award (2017).

Technologies: JavaScript, C#, .NET Web API 2, Angular, AngularJS, jQuery, CSS, SignalR, T-SQL, GitLab
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · C# · Object Oriented Design · AngularJS · Agile Methodologies · SignalR · .NET Framework · Git · Full-Stack Development · HTML · SQL Server Management Studio · TypeScript · JavaScript · ASP.NET MVC · jQuery · SQL · Visual Studio · Microsoft SQL Server · CSS · ASP.NET Web API · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · API Development · Databases · Software Development

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed MoGoMe, a healthcare-focused platform designed to securely connect users with social service providers.

	•	Built comprehensive application features including client surveys, contact management, emotional questionnaires, reporting and analytics, goal tracking, and geo-fenced activity monitoring.
	•	Engineered secure backend APIs and administrative role-based management interfaces, prioritizing data security, user privacy, and operational efficiency.
	•	Implemented frontend interfaces using Angular and responsive UI frameworks, creating an intuitive user experience.
	•	Utilized Agile methodologies with regular stand-ups, sprint cycles, and stakeholder demos to ensure continuous product alignment.

Technologies: JavaScript, Angular, jQuery, CSS, C#, T-SQL, .NET Framework 4.5, Web API 2, MVC 5, AWS S3, SendGrid, Bootstrap, Google Maps API, TFS
